text:
Type: adjustable metal desk lamp
Use: focused task light for reading and working at a desk; home office, study, bedroom
Style: industrial, retro, Scandinavian
Materials: powder-coated steel shade and arms, chrome-look joints and knobs, black fabric cord
Colors: light silver grey, chrome accents, black cord
Shape: bell-shaped shade with a vented top, two-part jointed arm with adjustment knobs, round weighted base, slim and angular, medium visual weight
Feel: practical, focused, crisp, utilitarian
Goes with: white or wood desks, grey and black accents, concrete or metal finishes; industrial or Scandinavian home offices

product.name: ARD
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm and head are adjustable.
